message.content: In an earlier conversation, LiHua shared an unforgettable match in "Call of Duty: Warzone." Specifically, LiHua mentioned a match where they were down to just two players, and they managed to outsmart the opposing team. This victory was described as a great team effort, highlighting the importance of strategy and cooperation in achieving success within the game. LiHua emphasized the adrenaline rush and excitement that comes from being in the final circle, underscoring the competitive yet collaborative nature of the game.
